result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-rendered. The main visual defect is a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel — 'Green Bowl Poké' appears twice back-to-back with identical image, time, and delivery fee, which looks like a data/rendering bug rather than intentional content.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant, 'Green Bowl Poké' (15–25 min, €0.90 delivery), twice in adjacent cards with identical images and metadata. This looks like a duplicated list item from a data or rendering bug and wastes carousel space.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering the carousel and verify the API response isn't returning duplicate entries.
